Doc.name: Class
Doc.summary: It represents a board for playing Tic-Tac-Toe or any other game, as long as it is 3 columns and 3 rows wide.

Doc.name: EmptyConstructor
Doc.summary: Create and returns a new Board of Tic-Tac-Toe.

Doc.name: Func:ValidateIntIndexers
Doc.summary: It checks if the values of the indexers are still within the board's range.

Doc.summary: Reset the board. It set all areas to empty.
